command: uv run python spikes/audit_rhoi_springs.py --work <folder outside the repo>

model.cube: spikes/t28_damped_cube.py feb_text: edge 10 mm, 48 tets, E 1000 MPa (soft cube without springs 0.005 MPa, base tied), 4 vertical linear springs K each to a fixed rigid frame, gravity from t = 0, 1 s, single thread; undamped (no mass damping) everywhere here

model_formulas: alpha_f = 1/(1+rho), alpha_m = (2-rho)/(1+rho), beta = (1+alpha_m-alpha_f)^2/4, gamma = 1/2+alpha_m-alpha_f (FEBio Theory Manual 3.6.5); rhoi -2: alpha 1, beta 1/4, gamma 1/2

region.rule: tet nodes held by no attachment whose nearest held node is one of lower_lip_on_jaw's spring nodes

model_one_frame_step.note: the 1-dof model at the lips' ~14 ms period and one step per frame (1/30 s): amplitude kept per step (spectral radius) and the period it would show; the lips mix tissue (consistent) and springs, so model only

q1_map.nosprings_reference: Richardson extrapolation of the Newmark periods at dt 1/600 and 1/1200: (4 T_1200 - T_600) / 3

baseline.what: spikes/t28_damped_cube.py as it is: 4 'linear spring' discrete elements, far end on a fixed rigid body

anchors_fixed_nodes.what: the springs' far ends fixed by a zero displacement boundary condition, not joined to the rigid frame

tension_only.what: discrete material 'tension-only linear spring' instead of 'linear spring'

nonlinear_spring.what: discrete material 'nonlinear spring' instead of 'linear spring'

truss.what: 4 line2 'linear-truss' elements (E A / L = K, A = 1.0, density 1e-6 of the cube's) instead of the discrete springs

rigid_spring.what: the cube made a rigid body (same density) and the 4 springs written as 'rigid spring' connectors to the fixed frame (the springs' far-end nodes are then in no element; FEBio removes them)

generator_control.what: the Control lines generate.py adds: plot/output at must points, the default time stepper with max_retries 8, opt_iter 10, dtmin dt/256, dtmax dt on a must-point curve (here a must point every step)

q3_convergence.note: FEBio's convergence norms are squared norms; 'residual_last_over_initial' is of those

q3_springs_rhoi1_full_newton_x100.failure: did not converge: Max nr of reformations reached.

q3_springs_rhoi1_full_newton_rtol_1e-6.failure: did not converge: Max nr of reformations reached.

rhoi_1.terms: kinetic 0.5 M |v_centre|^2, springs 0.5 K (L - L0)^2 each, cube strain sum(sed x V_tet), gravity M g (z - z0)

rhoi_0.5.terms: kinetic 0.5 M |v_centre|^2, springs 0.5 K (L - L0)^2 each, cube strain sum(sed x V_tet), gravity M g (z - z0)

rhoi_-2.terms: kinetic 0.5 M |v_centre|^2, springs 0.5 K (L - L0)^2 each, cube strain sum(sed x V_tet), gravity M g (z - z0)
